message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerabilities newly reported or materially updated during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-29 13:10 IST to 2026-09-30 13:10 IST (2026-09-29 07:40 UTC to 2026-09-30 07:40 UTC) were confirmed as affecting the products and versions in `DLL_software_component.txt`.

This scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined with this scope.

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were found.

### Validation notes

- The GitHub Advisory Database returned no NuGet advisories updated in the scan window.
- A newly surfaced npm advisory for Moment.js, [CVE-2026-17495 / GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw), was reviewed but excluded: it affects Moment.js versions `>=2.29.2, <2.31.0`, while the assigned inventory lists version `2.2.1`.
- Other newly published npm advisories in the window did not match named components in the assigned inventory.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The required dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector and SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or updated in the scan window. The [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) and an in-window GitHub Advisory Database search produced no fresh MongoDB match.

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; no uncertain product-family match remained for a “Possible matches needing review” section.
